lines.trans: Mr Chun Yuqiao, I have already emailed you the minutes from the proposal meeting.
Are you still angry—about that cake in the studio yesterday?
Angry about what? I have forgotten it already.
Truthfully, Lin Jie and her team mean well toward you from the heart.
Whatever they say aloud, deep down they truly trust and admire you.
Is there anything else?
You pushed my overhaul plan straight into the meeting without even reading it beforehand.
Do you genuinely approve of the proposal I wrote?
I read it.
When?
The computer assigned to you in the editorial office used to be mine and still has my account.
Every file of yours syncs to me—including every single picture you browse online.
So the conservative plan on the meeting desktop was swapped for the overhaul plan by you?
Do you have any more questions?
